78:8.Saheeh International: And We created you in pairs.
78:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি তোমাদেরকে জোড়া জোড়া সৃষ্টি করেছি,

78:9.Pickthall: And have appointed your sleep for repose,
78:9.Saheeh International: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

78:10.Pickthall: And have appointed the night as a cloak,
78:10.Saheeh International: And made the night as clothing.

78:11.Pickthall: And have appointed the day for livelihood.
78:11.Saheeh International: And made the day for livelihood.

78:12.Pickthall: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
78:12.Saheeh International: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens].
78:12.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নির্মান করেছি তোমাদের মাথার উপর মজবুত সপ্ত-আকাশ।

78:13.Pickthall: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,
78:13.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং একটি উজ্জ্বল প্রদীপ সৃষ্টি করেছি।

78:14.Pickthall: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,
78:14.Saheeh International: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water.
78:14.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি জলধর মেঘমালা থেকে প্রচুর বৃষ্টিপাত করি,

78:15.Pickthall: Thereby to produce grain and plant,
78:15.Saheeh International: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation.
78:15.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যাতে তদ্দ্বারা উৎপন্ন করি শস্য, উদ্ভিদ।

78:17.Pickthall: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
78:17.Saheeh International: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

78:18.Pickthall: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
78:18.Saheeh International: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
78:18.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যেদিন শিংগায় ফুঁক দেয়া হবে, তখন তোমরা দলে দলে সমাগত হবে।

78:19.Pickthall: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
78:19.Saheeh International: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways.
78:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আকাশ বিদীর্ণ হয়ে; তাতে বহু দরজা সৃষ্টি হবে।

78:20.Pickthall: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.
78:20.Saheeh International: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
78:20.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং পর্বতমালা চালিত হয়ে মরীচিকা হয়ে যাবে।

78:21.Saheeh International: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

78:22.Saheeh International: For the transgressors, a place of return,

78:23.Pickthall: They will abide therein for ages.
78:23.Saheeh International: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
78:23.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তারা তথায় শতাব্দীর পর শতাব্দী অবস্থান করবে।

78:24.Pickthall: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
78:24.Saheeh International: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.
78:24.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তথায় তারা কোন শীতল এবং পানীয় আস্বাদন করবে না;

78:25.Pickthall: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:
78:25.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কিন্তু ফুটন্ত পানি ও পূঁজ পাবে।

78:27.Pickthall: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;
78:27.Saheeh International: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
78:27.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় তারা হিসাব-নিকাশ আশা করত না।

78:28.Pickthall: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.
78:28.Saheeh International: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
78:28.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং আমার আয়াতসমূহে পুরোপুরি মিথ্যারোপ করত।

78:29.Pickthall: Everything have We recorded in a Book.
78:29.Saheeh International: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
78:29.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি সবকিছুই লিপিবদ্ধ করে সংরক্ষিত করেছি।

78:30.Pickthall: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.
78:30.Saheeh International: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
78:30.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, তোমরা আস্বাদন কর, আমি কেবল তোমাদের শাস্তিই বৃদ্ধি করব।

78:31.Pickthall: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -
78:31.Saheeh International: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

78:33.Pickthall: And voluptuous women of equal age;

78:35.Pickthall: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -
78:35.Saheeh International: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
78:35.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তারা তথায় অসার ও মিথ্যা বাক্য শুনবে না।

78:36.Pickthall: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
78:36.Saheeh International: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
78:36.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এটা আপনার পালনকর্তার তরফ থেকে যথোচিত দান,

78:37.Pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
78:37.Saheeh International: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
78:37.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যিনি নভোমন্ডল, ভূমন্ডল ও এতদুভয়ের মধ্যবর্তী সবকিছুর পালনকর্তা, দয়াময়, কেউ তাঁর সাথে কথার অধিকারী হবে না।

78:38.Pickthall: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
78:38.Saheeh International: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
78:38.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যেদিন রূহ ও ফেরেশতাগণ সারিবদ্ধভাবে দাঁড়াবে। দয়াময় আল্লাহ যাকে অনুমতি দিবেন, সে ব্যতিত কেউ কথা বলতে পারবে না এবং সে সত্যকথা বলবে।

78:39.Pickthall: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
78:39.Saheeh International: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
78:39.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এই দিবস সত্য। অতঃপর যার ইচ্ছা, সে তার পালনকর্তার কাছে ঠিকানা তৈরী করুক।

78:40.Pickthall: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
78:40.Saheeh International: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
78:40.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি তোমাদেরকে আসন্ন শাস্তি সম্পর্কে সতর্ক করলাম, যেদিন মানুষ প্রত্যেক্ষ করবে যা সে সামনে প্রেরণ করেছে এবং কাফের বলবেঃ হায়, আফসোস-আমি যদি মাটি হয়ে যেতাম।

79:1.Pickthall: By those who drag forth to destruction,
79:1.Saheeh International: By those [angels] who extract with violence
79:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ সেই ফেরেশতাগণের, যারা ডুব দিয়ে আত্মা উৎপাটন করে,

79:2.Saheeh International: And [by] those who remove with ease
79:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ তাদের, যারা আত্মার বাঁধন খুলে দেয় মৃদুভাবে;

79:3.Saheeh International: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
79:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ তাদের, যারা সন্তরণ করে দ্রুতগতিতে,

79:4.Saheeh International: And those who race each other in a race
79:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ তাদের, যারা দ্রুতগতিতে অগ্রসর হয় এবং

79:5.Pickthall: And those who govern the event,
79:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ তাদের, যারা সকল কর্মনির্বাহ করে, কেয়ামত অবশ্যই হবে।

79:6.Pickthall: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.
79:6.Saheeh International: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

79:7.Saheeh International: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

79:8.Pickthall: On that day hearts beat painfully

79:10.Pickthall: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state
79:10.Saheeh International: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
79:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তারা বলেঃ আমরা কি উলটো পায়ে প্রত্যাবর্তিত হবই-

79:11.Pickthall: Even after we are crumbled bones?
79:11.Saheeh International: Even if we should be decayed bones?"

79:12.Pickthall: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
79:12.Saheeh International: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
79:12.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তবে তো এ প্রত্যাবর্তন সর্বনাশা হবে!

79:13.Pickthall: Surely it will need but one shout,
79:13.Saheeh International: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
79:13.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, এটা তো কেবল এক মহা-নাদ,

79:14.Pickthall: And lo! they will be awakened.
79:14.Saheeh International: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

79:15.Pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?
79:15.Saheeh International: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
79:15.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): মূসার বৃত্তান্ত আপনার কাছে পৌছেছে কি?

79:16.Pickthall: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,
79:16.Saheeh International: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,
79:16.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন তার পালনকর্তা তাকে পবিত্র তুয়া উপ্যকায় আহবান করেছিলেন,

79:17.Pickthall: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -
79:17.Saheeh International: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
79:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): ফেরাউনের কাছে যাও, নিশ্চয় সে সীমালংঘন করেছে।

79:18.Pickthall: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?
79:18.Saheeh International: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
79:18.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর বলঃ তোমার পবিত্র হওয়ার আগ্রহ আছে কি?

79:19.Pickthall: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).
79:19.Saheeh International: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
79:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি তোমাকে তোমার পালনকর্তার দিকে পথ দেখাব, যাতে তুমি তাকে ভয় কর।

79:20.Pickthall: And he showed him the tremendous token.
79:20.Saheeh International: And he showed him the greatest sign,

79:21.Saheeh International: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.
79:21.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কিন্তু সে মিথ্যারোপ করল এবং অমান্য করল।

79:22.Pickthall: Then turned he away in haste,
79:22.Saheeh International: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].
79:22.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর সে প্রতিকার চেষ্টায় প্রস্থান করল।

79:23.Saheeh International: And he gathered [his people] and called out.
79:23.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে সকলকে সমবেত করল এবং সজোরে আহবান করল,

79:24.Pickthall: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."
79:24.Saheeh International: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
79:24.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং বললঃ আমিই তোমাদের সেরা পালনকর্তা।

79:25.Pickthall: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.
79:25.Saheeh International: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]..
79:25.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর আল্লাহ তাকে পরকালের ও ইহকালের শাস্তি দিলেন।

79:26.Pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.
79:26.Saheeh International: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].
79:26.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যে ভয় করে তার জন্যে অবশ্যই এতে শিক্ষা রয়েছে।

79:27.Pickthall: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?
79:27.Saheeh International: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.
79:27.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তোমাদের সৃষ্টি অধিক কঠিন না আকাশের, যা তিনি নির্মাণ করেছেন?

79:28.Pickthall: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;
79:28.Saheeh International: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
79:28.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি একে উচ্চ করেছেন ও সুবিন্যস্ত করেছেন।

79:29.Pickthall: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.
79:29.Saheeh International: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
79:29.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি এর রাত্রিকে করেছেন অন্ধকারাচ্ছন্ন এবং এর সূর্যোলোক প্রকাশ করেছেন।

79:30.Pickthall: And after that He spread the earth,
79:30.Saheeh International: And after that He spread the earth.

79:31.Pickthall: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,
79:31.Saheeh International: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
79:31.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি এর মধ্য থেকে এর পানি ও ঘাম নির্গত করেছেন,

79:32.Pickthall: And He made fast the hills,
79:32.Saheeh International: And the mountains He set firmly

79:33.Pickthall: A provision for you and for your cattle.
79:33.Saheeh International: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
79:33.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তোমাদের ও তোমাদের চতুস্পদ জন্তুদের উপকারার্থে।

79:34.Pickthall: But when the great disaster cometh,
79:34.Saheeh International: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -

79:35.Pickthall: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
79:35.Saheeh International: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
79:35.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অর্থাৎ যেদিন মানুষ তার কৃতকর্ম স্মরণ করবে

79:36.Pickthall: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,
79:36.Saheeh International: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
79:36.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং দর্শকদের জন্যে জাহান্নাম প্রকাশ করা হবে,

79:37.Pickthall: Then, as for him who rebelled
79:37.Saheeh International: So as for he who transgressed

79:38.Pickthall: And chose the life of the world,
79:38.Saheeh International: And preferred the life of the world,

79:39.Pickthall: Lo! hell will be his home.
79:39.Saheeh International: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

79:40.Pickthall: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,
79:40.Saheeh International: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
79:40.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): পক্ষান্তরে যে ব্যক্তি তার পালনকর্তার সামনে দন্ডায়মান হওয়াকে ভয় করেছে এবং খেয়াল-খুশী থেকে নিজেকে নিবৃত্ত রেখেছে,

79:41.Pickthall: Lo! the Garden will be his home.
79:41.Saheeh International: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

79:42.Pickthall: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?
79:42.Saheeh International: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
79:42.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তারা আপনাকে জিজ্ঞাসা করে, কেয়ামত কখন হবে?

79:43.Pickthall: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?
79:43.Saheeh International: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
79:43.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এর বর্ণনার সাথে আপনার কি সম্পর্ক ?

79:44.Pickthall: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.
79:44.Saheeh International: To your Lord is its finality.
79:44.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এর চরম জ্ঞান আপনার পালনকর্তার কাছে।

79:45.Pickthall: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
79:45.Saheeh International: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
79:45.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যে একে ভয় করে, আপনি তো কেবল তাকেই সতর্ক করবেন।

79:46.Pickthall: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
79:46.Saheeh International: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
79:46.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যেদিন তারা একে দেখবে, সেদিন মনে হবে যেন তারা দুনিয়াতে মাত্র এক সন্ধ্যা অথবা এক সকাল অবস্থান করেছে।

80:1.Saheeh International: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away
80:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি ভ্রূকুঞ্চিত করলেন এবং মুখ ফিরিয়ে নিলেন।

80:2.Pickthall: Because the blind man came unto him.
80:2.Saheeh International: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
80:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কারণ, তাঁর কাছে এক অন্ধ আগমন করল।

80:3.Pickthall: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
80:3.Saheeh International: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified
80:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনি কি জানেন, সে হয়তো পরিশুদ্ধ হত,

80:4.Pickthall: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?
80:4.Saheeh International: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
80:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অথবা উপদেশ গ্রহণ করতো এবং উপদেশ তার উপকার হত।

80:5.Pickthall: As for him who thinketh himself independent,
80:5.Saheeh International: As for he who thinks himself without need,

80:7.Pickthall: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).
80:7.Saheeh International: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
80:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে শুদ্ধ না হলে আপনার কোন দোষ নেই।

80:8.Pickthall: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
80:8.Saheeh International: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

80:11.Pickthall: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
80:11.Saheeh International: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;
80:11.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কখনও এরূপ করবেন না, এটা উপদেশবানী।

80:12.Pickthall: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,
80:12.Saheeh International: So whoever wills may remember it.
80:12.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, যে ইচ্ছা করবে, সে একে গ্রহণ করবে।

80:17.Saheeh International: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is man; how disbelieving is he.
80:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): মানুষ ধ্বংস হোক, সে কত অকৃতজ্ঞ!

80:18.Pickthall: From what thing doth He create him?
80:18.Saheeh International: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?
80:18.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি তাকে কি বস্তু থেকে সৃষ্টি করেছেন?

80:19.Pickthall: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
80:19.Saheeh International: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
80:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শুক্র থেকে তাকে সৃষ্টি করেছেন, অতঃপর তাকে সুপরিমিত করেছেন।

80:20.Pickthall: Then maketh the way easy for him,
80:20.Saheeh International: Then He eased the way for him;

80:21.Pickthall: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;
80:21.Saheeh International: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
80:21.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর তার মৃত্যু ঘটান ও কবরস্থ করেন তাকে।

80:22.Pickthall: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.
80:22.Saheeh International: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
80:22.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এরপর যখন ইচ্ছা করবেন তখন তাকে পুনরুজ্জীবিত করবেন।

80:23.Pickthall: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.
80:23.Saheeh International: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
80:23.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে কখনও কৃতজ্ঞ হয়নি, তিনি তাকে যা আদেশ করেছেন, সে তা পূর্ণ করেনি।

80:24.Saheeh International: Then let mankind look at his food -
80:24.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): মানুষ তার খাদ্যের প্রতি লক্ষ্য করুক,

80:25.Pickthall: How We pour water in showers
80:25.Saheeh International: How We poured down water in torrents,
80:25.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি আশ্চর্য উপায়ে পানি বর্ষণ করেছি,

80:26.Pickthall: Then split the earth in clefts
80:26.Saheeh International: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

80:27.Pickthall: And cause the grain to grow therein
80:27.Saheeh International: And caused to grow within it grain

80:32.Pickthall: Provision for you and your cattle.
80:32.Saheeh International: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

80:33.Saheeh International: But when there comes the Deafening Blast

80:34.Pickthall: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
80:34.Saheeh International: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
80:34.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সেদিন পলায়ন করবে মানুষ তার ভ্রাতার কাছ থেকে,

80:35.Pickthall: And his mother and his father
80:35.Saheeh International: And his mother and his father

80:36.Pickthall: And his wife and his children,
80:36.Saheeh International: And his wife and his children,
80:36.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তার পত্নী ও তার সন্তানদের কাছ থেকে।

80:37.Pickthall: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).
80:37.Saheeh International: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
80:37.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সেদিন প্রত্যেকেরই নিজের এক চিন্তা থাকবে, যা তাকে ব্যতিব্যস্ত করে রাখবে।

80:38.Pickthall: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,
80:38.Saheeh International: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

80:40.Pickthall: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,
80:40.Saheeh International: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
80:40.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং অনেক মুখমন্ডল সেদিন হবে ধুলি ধূসরিত।

80:42.Pickthall: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
80:42.Saheeh International: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

81:1.Saheeh International: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

81:2.Saheeh International: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

81:3.Pickthall: And when the hills are moved,
81:3.Saheeh International: And when the mountains are removed

81:4.Pickthall: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,
81:4.Saheeh International: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
81:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন দশ মাসের গর্ভবতী উষ্ট্রীসমূহ উপেক্ষিত হবে;

81:5.Pickthall: And when the wild beasts are herded together,
81:5.Saheeh International: And when the wild beasts are gathered
81:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন বন্য পশুরা একত্রিত হয়ে যাবে,

81:6.Saheeh International: And when the seas are filled with flame
81:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন সমুদ্রকে উত্তাল করে তোলা হবে,

81:7.Saheeh International: And when the souls are paired

81:8.Pickthall: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
81:8.Saheeh International: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
81:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন জীবন্ত প্রোথিত কন্যাকে জিজ্ঞেস করা হবে,

81:9.Pickthall: For what sin she was slain,
81:9.Saheeh International: For what sin she was killed
81:9.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কি অপরাধে তাকে হত্য করা হল?

81:10.Pickthall: And when the pages are laid open,
81:10.Saheeh International: And when the pages are spread [i.e., made public]

81:11.Pickthall: And when the sky is torn away,
81:11.Saheeh International: And when the sky is stripped away

81:12.Saheeh International: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
81:12.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন জাহান্নামের অগ্নি প্রজ্বলিত করা হবে

81:13.Pickthall: And when the Garden is brought nigh,
81:13.Saheeh International: And when Paradise is brought near,

81:14.Pickthall: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.
81:14.Saheeh International: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
81:14.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তখন প্রত্যেকেই জেনে নিবে সে কি উপস্থিত করেছে।

81:15.Pickthall: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,
81:15.Saheeh International: So I swear by the retreating stars -
81:15.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি শপথ করি যেসব নক্ষত্রগুলো পশ্চাতে সরে যায়।

81:16.Pickthall: The stars which rise and set,
81:16.Saheeh International: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]

81:17.Saheeh International: And by the night as it closes in

81:18.Saheeh International: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]

81:19.Pickthall: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,
81:19.Saheeh International: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]
81:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় কোরআন সম্মানিত রসূলের আনীত বাণী,

81:20.Pickthall: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
81:20.Saheeh International: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
81:20.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যিনি শক্তিশালী, আরশের মালিকের নিকট মর্যাদাশালী,

81:21.Saheeh International: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

81:22.Pickthall: And your comrade is not mad.
81:22.Saheeh International: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.

81:23.Pickthall: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.
81:23.Saheeh International: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.
81:23.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি সেই ফেরেশতাকে প্রকাশ্য দিগন্তে দেখেছেন।

81:24.Pickthall: And he is not avid of the Unseen.
81:24.Saheeh International: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
81:24.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি অদৃশ্য বিষয় বলতে কৃপনতা করেন না।

81:25.Pickthall: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.
81:25.Saheeh International: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

81:27.Pickthall: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
81:27.Saheeh International: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
81:27.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এটা তো কেবল বিশ্বাবাসীদের জন্যে উপদেশ,

81:28.Pickthall: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
81:28.Saheeh International: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
81:28.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তার জন্যে, যে তোমাদের মধ্যে সোজা চলতে চায়।

81:29.Pickthall: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.
81:29.Saheeh International: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.
81:29.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তোমরা আল্লাহ রাব্বুল আলামীনের অভিপ্রায়ের বাইরে অন্য কিছুই ইচ্ছা করতে পার না।

82:1.Pickthall: When the heaven is cleft asunder,

82:2.Saheeh International: And when the stars fall, scattering,

82:3.Pickthall: When the seas are poured forth,
82:3.Saheeh International: And when the seas are erupted
82:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন সমুদ্রকে উত্তাল করে তোলা হবে,

82:4.Saheeh International: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],

82:5.Pickthall: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.
82:5.Saheeh International: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
82:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তখন প্রত্যেকে জেনে নিবে সে কি অগ্রে প্রেরণ করেছে এবং কি পশ্চাতে ছেড়ে এসেছে।

82:6.Pickthall: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
82:6.Saheeh International: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
82:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): হে মানুষ, কিসে তোমাকে তোমার মহামহিম পালনকর্তা সম্পর্কে বিভ্রান্ত করল?

82:7.Pickthall: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?
82:7.Saheeh International: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
82:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যিনি তোমাকে সৃষ্টি করেছেন, অতঃপর তোমাকে সুবিন্যস্ত করেছেন এবং সুষম করেছেন।

82:8.Pickthall: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.
82:8.Saheeh International: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
82:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যিনি তোমাকে তাঁর ইচ্ছামত আকৃতিতে গঠন করেছেন।

82:9.Pickthall: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.
82:9.Saheeh International: No! But you deny the Recompense.
82:9.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কখনও বিভ্রান্ত হয়ো না; বরং তোমরা দান-প্রতিদানকে মিথ্যা মনে কর।

82:10.Pickthall: Lo! there are above you guardians,
82:10.Saheeh International: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
82:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অবশ্যই তোমাদের উপর তত্ত্বাবধায়ক নিযুক্ত আছে।

82:13.Pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.
82:13.Saheeh International: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

82:14.Pickthall: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;
82:14.Saheeh International: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

82:15.Pickthall: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
82:15.Saheeh International: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
82:15.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তারা বিচার দিবসে তথায় প্রবেশ করবে।

82:16.Pickthall: And will not be absent thence.
82:16.Saheeh International: And never therefrom will they be absent.
82:16.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তারা সেখান থেকে পৃথক হবে না।

82:17.Pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
82:17.Saheeh International: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

82:18.Pickthall: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
82:18.Saheeh International: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
82:18.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর আপনি জানেন, বিচার দিবস কি?

82:19.Pickthall: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.
82:19.Saheeh International: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.
82:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যেদিন কেউ কারও কোন উপকার করতে পারবে না এবং সেদিন সব কতৃꦣ2468;্ব হবে আল্লাহর।

83:1.Saheeh International: Woe to those who give less [than due],
83:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যারা মাপে কম করে, তাদের জন্যে দুর্ভোগ,

83:2.Pickthall: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,
83:2.Saheeh International: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
83:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যারা লোকের কাছ থেকে যখন মেপে নেয়, তখন পূর্ণ মাত্রায় নেয়

83:3.Pickthall: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.
83:3.Saheeh International: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
83:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং যখন লোকদেরকে মেপে দেয় কিংবা ওজন করে দেয়, তখন কম করে দেয়।

83:4.Pickthall: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
83:4.Saheeh International: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
83:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তারা কি চিন্তা করে না যে, তারা পুনরুত্থিত হবে।

83:6.Pickthall: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
83:6.Saheeh International: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
83:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যেদিন মানুষ দাঁড়াবে বিশ্ব পালনকর্তার সামনে।

83:7.Pickthall: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -
83:7.Saheeh International: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
83:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এটা কিছুতেই উচিত নয়, নিশ্চয় পাপাচারীদের আমলনামা সিজ্জীনে আছে।

83:8.Pickthall: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -
83:8.Saheeh International: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

83:9.Saheeh International: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.

83:10.Pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
83:10.Saheeh International: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

83:11.Pickthall: Those who deny the Day of Judgment
83:11.Saheeh International: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

83:12.Pickthall: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,
83:12.Saheeh International: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
83:12.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): প্রত্যেক সীমালংঘনকারী পাপিষ্ঠই কেবল একে মিথ্যারোপ করে।

83:13.Pickthall: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
83:13.Saheeh International: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
83:13.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তার কাছে আমার আয়াতসমূহ পাঠ করা হলে সে বলে, পুরাকালের উপকথা।

83:14.Pickthall: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.
83:14.Saheeh International: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
83:14.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কখনও না, বরং তারা যা করে, তাই তাদের হৃদয় মরিচা ধরিয়ে দিয়েছে।

83:15.Pickthall: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.
83:15.Saheeh International: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
83:15.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কখনও না, তারা সেদিন তাদের পালনকর্তার থেকে পর্দার অন্তরালে থাকবে।

83:16.Pickthall: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,
83:16.Saheeh International: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

83:17.Pickthall: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.
83:17.Saheeh International: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
83:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এরপর বলা হবে, একেই তো তোমরা মিথ্যারোপ করতে।

83:18.Pickthall: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -
83:18.Saheeh International: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.
83:18.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কখনও না, নিশ্চয় সৎলোকদের আমলনামা আছে ইল্লিয়্যীনে।

83:19.Pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -
83:19.Saheeh International: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?

83:20.Saheeh International: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

83:21.Pickthall: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).
83:21.Saheeh International: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].
83:21.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আল্লাহর নৈকট্যপ্রাপ্ত ফেরেশতাগণ একে প্রত্যক্ষ করে।

83:22.Pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,
83:22.Saheeh International: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

83:24.Pickthall: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.
83:24.Saheeh International: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
83:24.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনি তাদের মুখমন্ডলে স্বাচ্ছন্দ্যের সজীবতা দেখতে পাবেন।

83:25.Pickthall: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,
83:25.Saheeh International: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
83:25.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তাদেরকে মোহর করা বিশুদ্ধ পানীয় পান করানো হবে।

83:26.Pickthall: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -
83:26.Saheeh International: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
83:26.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তার মোহর হবে কস্তুরী। এ বিষয়ে প্রতিযোগীদের প্রতিযোগিতা করা উচিত।

83:27.Pickthall: And mixed with water of Tasnim,
83:27.Saheeh International: And its mixture is of Tasneem,

83:28.Pickthall: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.
83:28.Saheeh International: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.
83:28.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এটা একটা ঝরণা, যার পানি পান করবে নৈকট্যশীলগণ।

83:29.Pickthall: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
83:29.Saheeh International: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
83:29.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যারা অপরাধী, তারা বিশ্বাসীদেরকে উপহাস করত।

83:30.Pickthall: And wink one to another when they passed them;
83:30.Saheeh International: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
83:30.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং তারা যখন তাদের কাছ দিয়ে গমন করত তখন পরস্পরে চোখ টিপে ইশারা করত।

83:31.Pickthall: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;
83:31.Saheeh International: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
83:31.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তারা যখন তাদের পরিবার-পরিজনের কাছে ফিরত, তখনও হাসাহাসি করে ফিরত।

83:32.Pickthall: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.
83:32.Saheeh International: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
83:32.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আর যখন তারা বিশ্বাসীদেরকে দেখত, তখন বলত, নিশ্চয় এরা বিভ্রান্ত।

83:33.Pickthall: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
83:33.Saheeh International: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
83:33.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অথচ তারা বিশ্বাসীদের তত্ত্বাবধায়করূপে প্রেরিত হয়নি।

83:34.Pickthall: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,
83:34.Saheeh International: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
83:34.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আজ যারা বিশ্বাসী, তারা কাফেরদেরকে উপহাস করছে।

83:36.Pickthall: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?
83:36.Saheeh International: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
83:36.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কাফেররা যা করত, তার প্রতিফল পেয়েছে তো?

84:1.Pickthall: When the heaven is split asunder

84:2.Pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear,
84:2.Saheeh International: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
84:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): ও তার পালনকর্তার আদেশ পালন করবে এবং আকাশ এরই উপযুক্ত

84:3.Pickthall: And when the earth is spread out
84:3.Saheeh International: And when the earth has been extended
84:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং যখন পৃথিবীকে সম্প্রসারিত করা হবে।

84:4.Pickthall: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
84:4.Saheeh International: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it].
84:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং পৃথিবী তার গর্ভস্থিত সবকিছু বাইরে নিক্ষেপ করবে ও শুন্যগর্ভ হয়ে যাবে।

84:5.Pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear!
84:5.Saheeh International: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
84:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং তার পালনকর্তার আদেশ পালন করবে এবং পৃথিবী এরই উপযুক্ত।

84:6.Pickthall: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).
84:6.Saheeh International: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
84:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): হে মানুষ, তোমাকে তোমরা পালনকর্তা পর্যন্ত পৌছতে কষ্ট স্বীকার করতে হবে, অতঃপর তার সাক্ষাৎ ঘটবে।

84:7.Pickthall: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand
84:7.Saheeh International: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
84:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যাকে তার আমলনামা ডান হাতে দেয়া হবে

84:8.Pickthall: He truly will receive an easy reckoning
84:8.Saheeh International: He will be judged with an easy account

84:9.Pickthall: And will return unto his folk in joy.
84:9.Saheeh International: And return to his people in happiness.
84:9.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং সে তার পরিবার-পরিজনের কাছে হৃষ্টচিত্তে ফিরে যাবে

84:10.Pickthall: But whoso is given his account behind his back,
84:10.Saheeh International: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
84:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং যাকে তার আমলনামা পিঠের পশ্চাদ্দিক থেকে দেয়া, হবে,

84:11.Saheeh International: He will cry out for destruction

84:12.Pickthall: And be thrown to scorching fire.
84:12.Saheeh International: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

84:13.Pickthall: He verily lived joyous with his folk,
84:13.Saheeh International: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
84:13.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে তার পরিবার-পরিজনের মধ্যে আনন্দিত ছিল।

84:14.Pickthall: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).
84:14.Saheeh International: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].
84:14.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে মনে করত যে, সে কখনও ফিরে যাবে না।

84:15.Pickthall: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!
84:15.Saheeh International: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.
84:15.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কেন যাবে না, তার পালনকর্তা তো তাকে দেখতেন।

84:16.Pickthall: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,
84:16.Saheeh International: So I swear by the twilight glow
84:16.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি শপথ করি সন্ধ্যাকালীন লাল আভার

84:17.Pickthall: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,
84:17.Saheeh International: And [by] the night and what it envelops
84:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং রাত্রির, এবং তাতে যার সমাবেশ ঘটে

84:18.Pickthall: And by the moon when she is at the full,
84:18.Saheeh International: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
84:18.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং চন্দ্রের, যখন তা পূর্ণরূপ লাভ করে,

84:19.Pickthall: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.
84:19.Saheeh International: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.
84:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় তোমরা এক সিঁড়ি থেকে আরেক সিঁড়িতে আরোহণ করবে।

84:20.Pickthall: What aileth them, then, that they believe not
84:20.Saheeh International: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
84:20.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, তাদের কি হল যে, তারা ঈমান আনে না?

84:21.Pickthall: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?
84:21.Saheeh International: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?
84:21.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন তাদের কাছে কোরআন পাঠ করা হয়, তখন সেজদা করে না।

84:22.Pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;
84:22.Saheeh International: But those who have disbelieved deny,
84:22.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): বরং কাফেররা এর প্রতি মিথ্যারোপ করে।

84:23.Pickthall: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.
84:23.Saheeh International: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
84:23.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তারা যা সংরক্ষণ করে, আল্লাহ তা জানেন।

84:24.Pickthall: So give them tidings of a painful doom,
84:24.Saheeh International: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
84:24.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, তাদেরকে যন্ত্রণাদায়ক শাস্তির সুসংবাদ দিন।

84:25.Pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.
84:25.Saheeh International: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
84:25.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কিন্তু যারা বিশ্বাস স্থাপন করে ও সৎকর্ম করে, তাদের জন্য রয়েছে অফুরন্ত পুরস্কার।

85:1.Pickthall: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,
85:1.Saheeh International: By the sky containing great stars

85:3.Pickthall: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,
85:3.Saheeh International: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
85:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং সেই দিবসের, যে উপস্থিত হয় ও যাতে উপস্থিত হয়

85:4.Pickthall: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch
85:4.Saheeh International: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench

85:6.Saheeh International: When they were sitting near it.

85:7.Pickthall: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.
85:7.Saheeh International: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
85:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং তারা বিশ্বাসীদের সাথে যা করেছিল, তা নিরীক্ষণ করছিল।

85:8.Pickthall: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,
85:8.Saheeh International: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
85:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তারা তাদেরকে শাস্তি দিয়েছিল শুধু এ কারণে যে, তারা প্রশংসিত, পরাক্রান্ত আল্লাহর প্রতি বিশ্বাস স্থাপন করেছিল,

85:9.Pickthall: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.
85:9.Saheeh International: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.
85:9.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যিনি নভোমন্ডল ও ভূমন্ডলের ক্ষমতার মালিক, আল্লাহর সামনে রয়েছে সবকিছু।

85:10.Pickthall: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.
85:10.Saheeh International: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
85:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যারা মুমিন পুরুষ ও নারীকে নিপীড়ন করেছে, অতঃপর তওবা করেনি, তাদের জন্যে আছে জাহান্নামের শাস্তি, আর আছে দহন যন্ত্রণা,

85:11.Pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.
85:11.Saheeh International: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
85:11.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যারা ঈমান আনে ও সৎকর্ম করে তাদের জন্যে আছে জান্নাত, যার তলদেশে প্রবাহিত হয় নির্ঝরিণীসমূহ। এটাই মহাসাফল্য।

85:12.Pickthall: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.
85:12.Saheeh International: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.
85:12.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় তোমার পালনকর্তার পাকড়াও অত্যন্ত কঠিন।

85:13.Pickthall: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,
85:13.Saheeh International: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
85:13.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনিই প্রথমবার অস্তিত্ব দান করেন এবং পুনরায় জীবিত করেন।

85:14.Pickthall: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,
85:14.Saheeh International: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

85:15.Pickthall: Lord of the Throne of Glory,

85:17.Pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts
85:17.Saheeh International: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
85:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনার কাছে সৈন্যবাহিনীর ইতিবৃত্ত পৌছেছে কি?

85:18.Pickthall: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?

85:19.Pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial
85:19.Saheeh International: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
85:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): বরং যারা কাফের, তারা মিথ্যারোপে রত আছে।

85:20.Pickthall: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.
85:20.Saheeh International: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.
85:20.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আল্লাহ তাদেরকে চতুর্দিক থেকে পরিবেষ্টন করে রেখেছেন।

85:21.Pickthall: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.
85:21.Saheeh International: But this is an honored Qur’ān

86:1.Pickthall: By the heaven and the Morning Star
86:1.Saheeh International: By the sky and the night comer

86:2.Pickthall: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!
86:2.Saheeh International: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
86:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনি জানেন, যে রাত্রিতে আসে সেটা কি?

86:4.Pickthall: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.
86:4.Saheeh International: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

86:5.Pickthall: So let man consider from what he is created.
86:5.Saheeh International: So let man observe from what he was created.
86:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, মানুষের দেখা উচিত কি বস্তু থেকে সে সৃজিত হয়েছে।

86:6.Pickthall: He is created from a gushing fluid
86:6.Saheeh International: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
86:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে সৃজিত হয়েছে সবেগে স্খলিত পানি থেকে।

86:7.Pickthall: That issued from between the loins and ribs.
86:7.Saheeh International: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
86:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এটা নির্গত হয় মেরুদন্ড ও বক্ষপাজরের মধ্য থেকে।

86:8.Pickthall: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
86:8.Saheeh International: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.
86:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় তিনি তাকে ফিরিয়ে নিতে সক্ষম।

86:9.Pickthall: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.
86:9.Saheeh International: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

86:10.Pickthall: Then will he have no might nor any helper.
86:10.Saheeh International: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.
86:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সেদিন তার কোন শক্তি থাকবে না এবং সাহায্যকারীও থাকবে না।

86:11.Pickthall: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,
86:11.Saheeh International: By the sky which sends back

86:12.Pickthall: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)

86:13.Pickthall: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,
86:13.Saheeh International: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,

86:15.Pickthall: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
86:15.Saheeh International: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

86:16.Pickthall: And I plot a plot (against them).
86:16.Saheeh International: But I am planning a plan.

86:17.Pickthall: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.
86:17.Saheeh International: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
86:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, কাফেরদেরকে অবকাশ দিন, তাদেরকে অবকাশ দিন, কিছু দিনের জন্যে।

87:1.Pickthall: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,
87:1.Saheeh International: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
87:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনি আপনার মহান পালনকর্তার নামের পবিত্রতা বর্ণনা করুন

87:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যিনি সৃষ্টি করেছেন ও সুবিন্যস্ত করেছেন।

87:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং যিনি সুপরিমিত করেছেন ও পথ প্রদর্শন করেছেন

87:4.Saheeh International: And who brings out the pasture

87:5.Pickthall: Then turneth it to russet stubble.

87:6.Pickthall: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget
87:6.Saheeh International: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,
87:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি আপনাকে পাঠ করাতে থাকব, ফলে আপনি বিস্মৃত হবেন না

87:7.Pickthall: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;
87:7.Saheeh International: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
87:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আল্লাহ যা ইচ্ছা করেন তা ব্যতীত। নিশ্চয় তিনি জানেন প্রকাশ্য ও গোপন বিষয়।

87:8.Pickthall: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.
87:8.Saheeh International: And We will ease you toward ease.
87:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি আপনার জন্যে সহজ শরীয়ত সহজতর করে দেবো।

87:9.Pickthall: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
87:9.Saheeh International: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
87:9.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): উপদেশ ফলপ্রসূ হলে উপদেশ দান করুন,

87:10.Saheeh International: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.
87:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যে ভয় করে, সে উপদেশ গ্রহণ করবে,

87:11.Pickthall: But the most hapless will flout it,
87:11.Saheeh International: But the wretched one will avoid it
87:11.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আর যে, হতভাগা, সে তা উপেক্ষা করবে,

87:12.Pickthall: He who will be flung to the great Fire
87:12.Saheeh International: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

87:13.Pickthall: Wherein he will neither die nor live.
87:13.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর সেখানে সে মরবেও না, জীবিতও থাকবে না।

87:14.Saheeh International: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
87:14.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় সাফল্য লাভ করবে সে, যে শুদ্ধ হয়

87:15.Pickthall: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,
87:15.Saheeh International: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
87:15.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং তার পালনকর্তার নাম স্মরণ করে, অতঃপর নামায আদায় করে।

87:16.Pickthall: But ye prefer the life of the world
87:16.Saheeh International: But you prefer the worldly life,
87:16.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): বস্তুতঃ তোমরা পার্থিব জীবনকে অগ্রাধিকার দাও,

87:17.Pickthall: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
87:17.Saheeh International: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
87:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অথচ পরকালের জীবন উৎকৃষ্ট ও স্থায়ী।

87:18.Pickthall: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.
87:18.Saheeh International: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

87:19.Pickthall: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
87:19.Saheeh International: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

88:1.Pickthall: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?
88:1.Saheeh International: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
88:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনার কাছে আচ্ছন্নকারী কেয়ামতের বৃত্তান্ত পৌঁছেছে কি?

88:2.Pickthall: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,
88:2.Saheeh International: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,

88:4.Saheeh International: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

88:5.Saheeh International: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
88:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তাদেরকে ফুটন্ত নহর থেকে পান করানো হবে।

88:6.Pickthall: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit
88:6.Saheeh International: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
88:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কন্টকপূর্ণ ঝাড় ব্যতীত তাদের জন্যে কোন খাদ্য নেই।

88:7.Pickthall: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.
88:7.Saheeh International: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
88:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এটা তাদেরকে পুষ্ট করবে না এবং ক্ষুধায়ও উপকার করবে না।

88:8.Pickthall: In that day other faces will be calm,
88:8.Saheeh International: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

88:11.Pickthall: Where they hear no idle speech,
88:11.Saheeh International: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
88:11.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তথায় শুনবে না কোন অসার কথাবার্তা।

88:12.Saheeh International: Within it is a flowing spring.

88:13.Saheeh International: Within it are couches raised high

88:17.Pickthall: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?
88:17.Saheeh International: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
88:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তারা কি উষ্ট্রের প্রতি লক্ষ্য করে না যে, তা কিভাবে সৃষ্টি করা হয়েছে?

88:18.Pickthall: And the heaven, how it is raised?
88:18.Saheeh International: And at the sky - how it is raised?
88:18.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং আকাশের প্রতি লক্ষ্য করে না যে, তা কিভাবে উচ্চ করা হয়েছে?

88:19.Pickthall: And the hills, how they are set up?
88:19.Saheeh International: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
88:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং পাহাড়ের দিকে যে, তা কিভাবে স্থাপন করা হয়েছে?

88:20.Pickthall: And the earth, how it is spread?
88:20.Saheeh International: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
88:20.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং পৃথিবীর দিকে যে, তা কিভাবে সমতল বিছানো হয়েছে?

88:21.Pickthall: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,
88:21.Saheeh International: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.
88:21.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, আপনি উপদেশ দিন, আপনি তো কেবল একজন উপদেশদাতা,

88:22.Pickthall: Thou art not at all a warder over them.
88:22.Saheeh International: You are not over them a controller.

88:23.Pickthall: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,
88:23.Saheeh International: However, he who turns away and disbelieves
88:23.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কিন্তু যে মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয় ও কাফের হয়ে যায়,

88:24.Pickthall: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.
88:24.Saheeh International: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

88:25.Pickthall: Lo! unto Us is their return
88:25.Saheeh International: Indeed, to Us is their return.

88:26.Saheeh International: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

89:3.Pickthall: And the Even and the Odd,
89:3.Saheeh International: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

89:4.Pickthall: And the night when it departeth,
89:4.Saheeh International: And [by] the night when it passes,
89:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং শপথ রাত্রির যখন তা গত হতে থাকে

89:5.Pickthall: There surely is an oath for thinking man.
89:5.Saheeh International: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
89:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এর মধ্যে আছে শপথ জ্ঞানী ব্যক্তির জন্যে।

89:6.Pickthall: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,
89:6.Saheeh International: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ʿAad -
89:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনি কি লক্ষ্য করেননি, আপনার পালনকর্তা আদ বংশের ইরাম গোত্রের সাথে কি আচরণ করেছিলেন,

89:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যাদের দৈহিক গঠন স্তম্ভ ও খুঁটির ন্যায় দীর্ঘ ছিল এবং

89:8.Pickthall: The like of which was not created in the lands;
89:8.Saheeh International: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
89:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যাদের সমান শক্তি ও বলবীর্যে সারা বিশ্বের শহরসমূহে কোন লোক সৃজিত হয়নি

89:9.Pickthall: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;
89:9.Saheeh International: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
89:9.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং সামুদ গোত্রের সাথে, যারা উপত্যকায় পাথর কেটে গৃহ নির্মাণ করেছিল।

89:10.Pickthall: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,
89:10.Saheeh International: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes?
89:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং বহু কীলকের অধিপতি ফেরাউনের সাথে

89:11.Pickthall: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,
89:11.Saheeh International: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

89:12.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর সেখানে বিস্তর অশান্তি সৃষ্টি করেছিল।

89:13.Pickthall: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.
89:13.Saheeh International: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
89:13.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর আপনার পালনকর্তা তাদেরকে শাস্তির কশাঘাত করলেন।

89:14.Pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.
89:14.Saheeh International: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
89:14.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় আপনার পালকর্তা সতর্ক দৃষ্টি রাখেন।

89:15.Pickthall: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
89:15.Saheeh International: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
89:15.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): মানুষ এরূপ যে, যখন তার পালনকর্তা তাকে পরীক্ষা করেন, অতঃপর সম্মান ও অনুগ্রহ দান করেন, তখন বলে, আমার পালনকর্তা আমাকে সম্মান দান করেছেন।

89:16.Pickthall: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
89:16.Saheeh International: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
89:16.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং যখন তাকে পরীক্ষা করেন, অতঃপর রিযিক সংকুচিত করে দেন, তখন বলেঃ আমার পালনকর্তা আমাকে হেয় করেছেন।

89:17.Pickthall: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
89:17.Saheeh International: No! But you do not honor the orphan
89:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এটা অমূলক, বরং তোমরা এতীমকে সম্মান কর না।

89:18.Pickthall: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.
89:18.Saheeh International: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
89:18.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং মিসকীনকে অন্নদানে পরস্পরকে উৎসাহিত কর না।

89:19.Pickthall: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.
89:19.Saheeh International: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
89:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং তোমরা মৃতের ত্যাজ্য সম্পত্তি সম্পূর্ণরূপে কুক্ষিগত করে ফেল

89:20.Pickthall: And love wealth with abounding love.
89:20.Saheeh International: And you love wealth with immense love.

89:21.Pickthall: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,
89:21.Saheeh International: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed
89:21.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এটা অনুচিত। যখন পৃথিবী চুর্ণ-বিচুর্ণ হবে

89:22.Pickthall: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,
89:22.Saheeh International: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
89:22.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং আপনার পালনকর্তা ও ফেরেশতাগণ সারিবদ্ধভাবে উপস্থিত হবেন,

89:23.Pickthall: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?
89:23.Saheeh International: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but how [i.e., what good] to him will be the remembrance?
89:23.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং সেদিন জাহান্নামকে আনা হবে, সেদিন মানুষ স্মরণ করবে, কিন্তু এই স্মরণ তার কি কাজে আসবে?

89:24.Pickthall: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!
89:24.Saheeh International: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
89:24.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে বলবেঃ হায়, এ জীবনের জন্যে আমি যদি কিছু অগ্রে প্রেরণ করতাম!

89:25.Pickthall: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!
89:25.Saheeh International: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
89:25.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সেদিন তার শাস্তির মত শাস্তি কেউ দিবে না।

89:26.Pickthall: None bindeth as He then will bind.
89:26.Saheeh International: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
89:26.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং তার বন্ধনের মত বন্ধন কেউ দিবে না।

89:27.Pickthall: But ah! thou soul at peace!
89:27.Saheeh International: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

89:28.Pickthall: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!
89:28.Saheeh International: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
89:28.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তুমি তোমার পালনকর্তার নিকট ফিরে যাও সন্তুষ্ট ও সন্তোষভাজন হয়ে।

89:29.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর আমার বান্দাদের অন্তর্ভুক্ত হয়ে যাও।

90:1.Pickthall: Nay, I swear by this city -
90:1.Saheeh International: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah]

90:2.Pickthall: And thou art an indweller of this city -
90:2.Saheeh International: And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city
90:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং এই নগরীতে আপনার উপর কোন প্রতিবন্ধকতা নেই।

90:3.Pickthall: And the begetter and that which he begat,
90:3.Saheeh International: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
90:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ জনকের ও যা জন্ম দেয়।

90:4.Pickthall: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:
90:4.Saheeh International: We have certainly created man into hardship.
90:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় আমি মানুষকে শ্রমনির্ভররূপে সৃষ্টি করেছি।

90:5.Pickthall: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?
90:5.Saheeh International: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
90:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে কি মনে করে যে, তার উপর কেউ ক্ষমতাবান হবে না ?

90:6.Pickthall: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:
90:6.Saheeh International: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
90:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে বলেঃ আমি প্রচুর ধন-সম্পদ ব্যয় করেছি।

90:7.Pickthall: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
90:7.Saheeh International: Does he think that no one has seen him?
90:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে কি মনে করে যে, তাকে কেউ দেখেনি?

90:8.Pickthall: Did We not assign unto him two eyes
90:8.Saheeh International: Have We not made for him two eyes?

90:9.Pickthall: And a tongue and two lips,
90:9.Saheeh International: And a tongue and two lips?

90:10.Pickthall: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?
90:10.Saheeh International: And have shown him the two ways?
90:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): বস্তুতঃ আমি তাকে দু’টি পথ প্রদর্শন করেছি।

90:11.Pickthall: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -
90:11.Saheeh International: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
90:11.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর সে ধর্মের ঘাঁটিতে প্রবেশ করেনি।

90:12.Pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -
90:12.Saheeh International: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?

90:13.Saheeh International: It is the freeing of a slave

90:14.Pickthall: And to feed in the day of hunger.
90:14.Saheeh International: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

90:16.Pickthall: Or some poor wretch in misery,
90:16.Saheeh International: Or a needy person in misery

90:17.Pickthall: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.
90:17.Saheeh International: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
90:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর তাদের অন্তর্ভুক্ত হওয়া, যারা ঈমান আনে এবং পরস্পরকে উপদেশ দেয় সবরের ও উপদেশ দেয় দয়ার।

90:18.Pickthall: Their place will be on the right hand.
90:18.Saheeh International: Those are the companions of the right.

90:19.Pickthall: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.
90:19.Saheeh International: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
90:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আর যারা আমার আয়াতসমূহ অস্বীকার করে তারাই হতভাগা।

90:20.Pickthall: Fire will be an awning over them.
90:20.Saheeh International: Over them will be fire closed in.

91:1.Pickthall: By the sun and his brightness,
91:1.Saheeh International: By the sun and its brightness

91:2.Pickthall: And the moon when she followeth him,
91:2.Saheeh International: And [by] the moon when it follows it
91:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ চন্দ্রের যখন তা সূর্যের পশ্চাতে আসে,

91:3.Pickthall: And the day when it revealeth him,
91:3.Saheeh International: And [by] the day when it displays it
91:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ দিবসের যখন সে সূর্যকে প্রখরভাবে প্রকাশ করে,

91:4.Pickthall: And the night when it enshroudeth him,
91:4.Saheeh International: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it
91:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ রাত্রির যখন সে সূর্যকে আচ্ছাদিত করে,

91:5.Pickthall: And the heaven and Him Who built it,
91:5.Saheeh International: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
91:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ আকাশের এবং যিনি তা নির্মাণ করেছেন, তাঁর।

91:6.Pickthall: And the earth and Him Who spread it,
91:6.Saheeh International: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
91:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ পৃথিবীর এবং যিনি তা বিস্তৃত করেছেন, তাঁর,

91:7.Pickthall: And a soul and Him Who perfected it
91:7.Saheeh International: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
91:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ প্রাণের এবং যিনি তা সুবিন্যস্ত করেছেন, তাঁর,

91:8.Pickthall: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.
91:8.Saheeh International: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
91:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর তাকে তার অসৎকর্ম ও সৎকর্মের জ্ঞান দান করেছেন,

91:9.Pickthall: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,
91:9.Saheeh International: He has succeeded who purifies it,
91:9.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যে নিজেকে শুদ্ধ করে, সেই সফলকাম হয়।

91:10.Pickthall: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.
91:10.Saheeh International: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
91:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং যে নিজেকে কলুষিত করে, সে ব্যর্থ মনোরথ হয়।

91:11.Pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,
91:11.Saheeh International: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
91:11.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সামুদ সম্প্রদায় অবাধ্যতা বশতঃ মিথ্যারোপ করেছিল।

91:12.Pickthall: When the basest of them broke forth
91:12.Saheeh International: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
91:12.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন তাদের সর্বাধিক হতভাগ্য ব্যক্তি তৎপর হয়ে উঠেছিল।

91:13.Pickthall: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!
91:13.Saheeh International: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."
91:13.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর আল্লাহর রসূল তাদেরকে বলেছিলেনঃ আল্লাহর উষ্ট্রী ও তাকে পানি পান করানোর ব্যাপারে সতর্ক থাক।

91:14.Pickthall: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).
91:14.Saheeh International: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
91:14.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর ওরা তার প্রতি মিথ্যারোপ করেছিল এবং উষ্ট্রীর পা কর্তন করেছিল। তাদের পাপের কারণে তাদের পালনকর্তা তাদের উপর ধ্বংস নাযিল করে একাকার করে দিলেন।

91:15.Pickthall: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).
91:15.Saheeh International: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
91:15.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আল্লাহ তা’আলা এই ধ্বংসের কোন বিরূপ পরিণতির আশংকা করেন না।

92:1.Saheeh International: By the night when it covers
92:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ রাত্রির, যখন সে আচ্ছন্ন করে,

92:2.Saheeh International: And [by] the day when it appears
92:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ দিনের, যখন সে আলোকিত হয়

92:3.Pickthall: And Him Who hath created male and female,
92:3.Saheeh International: And [by] He who created the male and female,
92:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং তাঁর, যিনি নর ও নারী সৃষ্টি করেছেন,

92:4.Pickthall: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).
92:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় তোমাদের কর্ম প্রচেষ্টা বিভিন্ন ধরনের।

92:5.Pickthall: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
92:5.Saheeh International: As for he who gives and fears Allāh
92:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, যে দান করে এবং খোদাভীরু হয়,

92:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং উত্তম বিষয়কে সত্য মনে করে,

92:7.Pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.
92:7.Saheeh International: We will ease him toward ease.
92:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি তাকে সুখের বিষয়ের জন্যে সহজ পথ দান করব।

92:8.Pickthall: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,
92:8.Saheeh International: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
92:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আর যে কৃপণতা করে ও বেপরওয়া হয়

92:9.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং উত্তম বিষয়কে মিথ্যা মনে করে,

92:10.Pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
92:10.Saheeh International: We will ease him toward difficulty.
92:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি তাকে কষ্টের বিষয়ের জন্যে সহজ পথ দান করব।

92:11.Pickthall: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.
92:11.Saheeh International: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
92:11.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন সে অধঃপতিত হবে, তখন তার সম্পদ তার কোনই কাজে আসবে না।

92:12.Pickthall: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance

92:13.Pickthall: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.
92:13.Saheeh International: And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
92:13.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আর আমি মালিক ইহকালের ও পরকালের।

92:14.Pickthall: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire
92:14.Saheeh International: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
92:14.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, আমি তোমাদেরকে প্রজ্বলিত অগ্নি সম্পর্কে সতর্ক করে দিয়েছি।

92:15.Pickthall: Which only the most wretched must endure,
92:15.Saheeh International: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
92:15.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এতে নিতান্ত হতভাগ্য ব্যক্তিই প্রবেশ করবে,

92:16.Pickthall: He who denieth and turneth away.
92:16.Saheeh International: Who had denied and turned away.
92:16.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যে মিথ্যারোপ করে ও মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয়।

92:17.Pickthall: Far removed from it will be the righteous
92:17.Saheeh International: But the righteous one will avoid it
92:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এ থেকে দূরে রাখা হবে খোদাভীরু ব্যক্তিকে,

92:18.Pickthall: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).
92:18.Saheeh International: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
92:18.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যে আত্নশুদ্ধির জন্যে তার ধন-সম্পদ দান করে।

92:19.Pickthall: And none hath with him any favour for reward,
92:19.Saheeh International: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
92:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং তার উপর কারও কোন প্রতিদানযোগ্য অনুগ্রহ থাকে না।

92:20.Pickthall: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
92:20.Saheeh International: But only seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of his Lord, Most High.
92:20.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তার মহান পালনকর্তার সন্তুষ্টি অন্বেষণ ব্যতীত।

92:21.Saheeh International: And he is going to be satisfied.

93:2.Pickthall: And by the night when it is stillest,
93:2.Saheeh International: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
93:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শপথ রাত্রির যখন তা গভীর হয়,

93:3.Pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,
93:3.Saheeh International: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].
93:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনার পালনকর্তা আপনাকে ত্যাগ করেনি এবং আপনার প্রতি বিরূপও হননি।

93:4.Pickthall: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,
93:4.Saheeh International: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
93:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনার জন্যে পরকাল ইহকাল অপেক্ষা শ্রেয়।

93:5.Pickthall: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
93:5.Saheeh International: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
93:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনার পালনকর্তা সত্বরই আপনাকে দান করবেন, অতঃপর আপনি সন্তুষ্ট হবেন।

93:6.Pickthall: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?
93:6.Saheeh International: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
93:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি কি আপনাকে এতীমরূপে পাননি? অতঃপর তিনি আশ্রয় দিয়েছেন।

93:7.Pickthall: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?
93:7.Saheeh International: And He found you lost and guided [you],
93:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি আপনাকে পেয়েছেন পথহারা, অতঃপর পথপ্রদর্শন করেছেন।

93:8.Pickthall: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?
93:8.Saheeh International: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
93:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি আপনাকে পেয়েছেন নিঃস্ব, অতঃপর অভাবমুক্ত করেছেন।

93:9.Saheeh International: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
93:9.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সুতরাং আপনি এতীমের প্রতি কঠোর হবেন না;

93:10.Pickthall: Therefor the beggar drive not away,
93:10.Saheeh International: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].

93:11.Pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
93:11.Saheeh International: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
93:11.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং আপনার পালনকর্তার নেয়ামতের কথা প্রকাশ করুন।

94:1.Pickthall: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,
94:1.Saheeh International: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?
94:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি কি আপনার বক্ষ উম্মুক্ত করে দেইনি?

94:2.Pickthall: And eased thee of the burden
94:2.Saheeh International: And We removed from you your burden

94:3.Saheeh International: Which had weighed upon your back
94:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যা ছিল আপনার জন্যে অতিশয় দুঃসহ।

94:4.Saheeh International: And raised high for you your repute.

94:5.Pickthall: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,
94:5.Saheeh International: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].

94:7.Pickthall: So when thou art relieved, still toil
94:7.Saheeh International: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
94:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, যখন অবসর পান পরিশ্রম করুন।

94:8.Pickthall: And strive to please thy Lord.
94:8.Saheeh International: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
94:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং আপনার পালনকর্তার প্রতি মনোনিবেশ করুন।

95:1.Pickthall: By the fig and the olive,
95:1.Saheeh International: By the fig and the olive

95:3.Pickthall: And by this land made safe;

95:4.Pickthall: Surely We created man of the best stature
95:4.Saheeh International: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
95:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি সৃষ্টি করেছি মানুষকে সুন্দরতর অবয়বে।

95:5.Pickthall: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,
95:5.Saheeh International: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
95:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর তাকে ফিরিয়ে দিয়েছি নীচ থেকে নীচে।

95:6.Pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.
95:6.Saheeh International: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
95:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কিন্তু যারা বিশ্বাস স্থাপন করেছে ও সৎকর্ম করেছে, তাদের জন্যে রয়েছে অশেষ পুরস্কার।

95:7.Pickthall: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?
95:7.Saheeh International: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
95:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর কেন তুমি অবিশ্বাস করছ কেয়ামতকে?

95:8.Pickthall: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?
95:8.Saheeh International: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?
95:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আল্লাহ কি বিচারকদের মধ্যে শ্রেষ্টতম বিচারক নন?

96:2.Saheeh International: Created man from a clinging substance.
96:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সৃষ্টি করেছেন মানুষকে জমাট রক্ত থেকে।

96:3.Pickthall: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,
96:3.Saheeh International: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
96:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): পাঠ করুন, আপনার পালনকর্তা মহা দয়ালু,

96:5.Pickthall: Teacheth man that which he knew not.
96:5.Saheeh International: Taught man that which he knew not.
96:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শিক্ষা দিয়েছেন মানুষকে যা সে জানত না।

96:6.Pickthall: Nay, but verily man is rebellious

96:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এ কারণে যে, সে নিজেকে অভাবমুক্ত মনে করে।

96:8.Pickthall: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.
96:8.Saheeh International: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
96:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় আপনার পালনকর্তার দিকেই প্রত্যাবর্তন হবে।

96:9.Pickthall: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
96:9.Saheeh International: Have you seen the one who forbids
96:9.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনি কি তাকে দেখেছেন, যে নিষেধ করে

96:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এক বান্দাকে যখন সে নামায পড়ে?

96:11.Pickthall: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
96:11.Saheeh International: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
96:11.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনি কি দেখেছেন যদি সে সৎপথে থাকে।

96:13.Pickthall: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?
96:13.Saheeh International: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
96:13.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনি কি দেখেছেন, যদি সে মিথ্যারোপ করে ও মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয়।

96:14.Pickthall: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?
96:14.Saheeh International: Does he not know that Allāh sees?
96:14.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে কি জানে না যে, আল্লাহ দেখেন?

96:15.Pickthall: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -
96:15.Saheeh International: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock
96:15.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কখনই নয়, যদি সে বিরত না হয়, তবে আমি মস্তকের সামনের কেশগুচ্ছ ধরে হেঁচড়াবই-

96:17.Pickthall: Then let him call upon his henchmen!
96:17.Saheeh International: Then let him call his associates;
96:17.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব, সে তার সভাসদদেরকে আহবান করুক।

96:18.Pickthall: We will call the guards of hell.
96:18.Saheeh International: We will call the angels of Hell.

96:19.Pickthall: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).
96:19.Saheeh International: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allāh].
96:19.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কখনই নয়, আপনি তার আনুগত্য করবেন না। আপনি সেজদা করুন ও আমার নৈকট্য অর্জন করুন।

97:1.Pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.
97:1.Saheeh International: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.

97:2.Pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!
97:2.Saheeh International: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

97:3.Pickthall: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
97:3.Saheeh International: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
97:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): শবে-কদর হল এক হাজার মাস অপেক্ষা শ্রেষ্ঠ।

97:4.Pickthall: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
97:4.Saheeh International: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
97:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এতে প্রত্যেক কাজের জন্যে ফেরেশতাগণ ও রূহ অবতীর্ণ হয় তাদের পালনকর্তার নির্দেশক্রমে।

97:5.Pickthall: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
97:5.Saheeh International: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
97:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এটা নিরাপত্তা, যা ফজরের উদয় পর্যন্ত অব্যাহত থাকে।

98:1.Pickthall: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them,
98:1.Saheeh International: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence
98:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আহলে-কিতাব ও মুশরেকদের মধ্যে যারা কাফের ছিল, তারা প্রত্যাবর্তন করত না যতক্ষণ না তাদের কাছে সুস্পষ্ট প্রমাণ আসত।

98:2.Pickthall: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages
98:2.Saheeh International: A Messenger from Allāh, reciting purified scriptures
98:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অর্থাৎ আল্লাহর একজন রসূল, যিনি আবৃত্তি করতেন পবিত্র সহীফা,

98:3.Saheeh International: Within which are correct writings [i.e., rulings and laws].

98:4.Pickthall: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them.
98:4.Saheeh International: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
98:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অপর কিতাব প্রাপ্তরা যে বিভ্রান্ত হয়েছে, তা হয়েছে তাদের কাছে সুস্পষ্ট প্রমাণ আসার পরেই।

98:5.Pickthall: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.
98:5.Saheeh International: And they were not commanded except to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakāh. And that is the correct religion.
98:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তাদেরকে এছাড়া কোন নির্দেশ করা হয়নি যে, তারা খাঁটি মনে একনিষ্ঠভাবে আল্লাহর এবাদত করবে, নামায কায়েম করবে এবং যাকাত দেবে। এটাই সঠিক ধর্ম।

98:6.Pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.
98:6.Saheeh International: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
98:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আহলে-কিতাব ও মুশরেকদের মধ্যে যারা কাফের, তারা জাহান্নামের আগুনে স্থায়ীভাবে থাকবে। তারাই সৃষ্টির অধম।

98:7.Pickthall: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings.
98:7.Saheeh International: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
98:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যারা ঈমান আনে ও সৎকর্ম করে, তারাই সৃষ্টির সেরা।
