98:8.Pickthall: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.
98:8.Saheeh International: Their reward with their Lord will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
98:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তাদের পালনকর্তার কাছে রয়েছে তাদের প্রতিদান চিরকাল বসবাসের জান্নাত, যার তলদেশে নির্ঝরিণী প্রবাহিত। তারা সেখানে থাকবে অনন্তকাল। আল্লাহ তাদের প্রতি সন্তুষ্ট এবং তারা আল্লাহর প্রতি সন্তুষ্ট। এটা তার জন্যে, যে তার পালনকর্তাকে ভয় কর।

99:1.Pickthall: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
99:1.Saheeh International: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
99:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন পৃথিবী তার কম্পনে প্রকম্পিত হবে,

99:2.Pickthall: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,
99:2.Saheeh International: And the earth discharges its burdens
99:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন সে তার বোঝা বের করে দেবে।

99:3.Pickthall: And man saith: What aileth her?
99:3.Saheeh International: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
99:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং মানুষ বলবে, এর কি হল ?

99:4.Pickthall: That day she will relate her chronicles,
99:4.Saheeh International: That Day, it will report its news
99:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সেদিন সে তার বৃত্তান্ত বর্ণনা করবে,

99:5.Saheeh International: Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.
99:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কারণ, আপনার পালনকর্তা তাকে আদেশ করবেন।

99:6.Pickthall: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
99:6.Saheeh International: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
99:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সেদিন মানুষ বিভিন্ন দলে প্রকাশ পাবে, যাতে তাদেরকে তাদের কৃতকর্ম দেখানো হয়।

99:7.Pickthall: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,
99:7.Saheeh International: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
99:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর কেউ অণু পরিমাণ সৎকর্ম করলে তা দেখতে পাবে

99:8.Pickthall: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.
99:8.Saheeh International: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
99:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং কেউ অণু পরিমাণ অসৎকর্ম করলে তাও দেখতে পাবে।

100:2.Saheeh International: And the producers of sparks [when] striking

100:3.Pickthall: And scouring to the raid at dawn,

100:4.Pickthall: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,
100:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): ও যারা সে সময়ে ধুলি উৎক্ষিপ্ত করে

100:5.Pickthall: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),
100:5.Saheeh International: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
100:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর যারা শক্রদলের অভ্যন্তরে ঢুকে পড়ে-

100:6.Pickthall: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
100:6.Saheeh International: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
100:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় মানুষ তার পালনকর্তার প্রতি অকৃতজ্ঞ।

100:7.Pickthall: And lo! he is a witness unto that;
100:7.Saheeh International: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
100:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং সে অবশ্য এ বিষয়ে অবহিত

100:8.Pickthall: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.
100:8.Saheeh International: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
100:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং সে নিশ্চিতই ধন-সম্পদের ভালবাসায় মত্ত।

100:9.Pickthall: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
100:9.Saheeh International: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
100:9.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে কি জানে না, যখন কবরে যা আছে, তা উত্থিত হবে

100:10.Pickthall: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,
100:10.Saheeh International: And that within the breasts is obtained,
100:10.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং অন্তরে যা আছে, তা অর্জন করা হবে?

100:11.Pickthall: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
100:11.Saheeh International: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.
100:11.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সেদিন তাদের কি হবে, সে সম্পর্কে তাদের পালনকর্তা সবিশেষ জ্ঞাত।

101:3.Pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!
101:3.Saheeh International: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

101:4.Pickthall: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths
101:4.Saheeh International: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
101:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যেদিন মানুষ হবে বিক্ষিপ্ত পতংগের মত

101:5.Pickthall: And the mountains will become as carded wool.
101:5.Saheeh International: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
101:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং পর্বতমালা হবে ধুনিত রঙ্গীন পশমের মত।

101:6.Pickthall: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),
101:6.Saheeh International: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],

101:7.Pickthall: He will live a pleasant life.
101:7.Saheeh International: He will be in a pleasant life.

101:8.Pickthall: But as for him whose scales are light,
101:8.Saheeh International: But as for one whose scales are light,

101:9.Pickthall: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,
101:9.Saheeh International: His refuge will be an abyss.

101:10.Pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -
101:10.Saheeh International: And what can make you know what that is?

101:11.Saheeh International: It is a Fire, intensely hot.

102:1.Pickthall: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you

102:2.Pickthall: Until ye come to the graves.

102:3.Pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
102:3.Saheeh International: No! You are going to know.
102:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এটা কখনও উচিত নয়। তোমরা সত্ত্বরই জেনে নেবে।

102:4.Pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
102:4.Saheeh International: Then, no! You are going to know.
102:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর এটা কখনও উচিত নয়। তোমরা সত্ত্বরই জেনে নেবে।

102:5.Pickthall: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!
102:5.Saheeh International: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
102:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কখনই নয়; যদি তোমরা নিশ্চিত জানতে।

102:6.Saheeh International: You will surely see the Hellfire.

102:7.Pickthall: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.
102:7.Saheeh International: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
102:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর তোমরা তা অবশ্যই দেখবে দিব্য প্রত্যয়ে,

102:8.Pickthall: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
102:8.Saheeh International: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
102:8.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এরপর অবশ্যই সেদিন তোমরা নেয়ামত সম্পর্কে জিজ্ঞাসিত হবে।

103:2.Pickthall: Lo! man is a state of loss,

103:3.Pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.
103:3.Saheeh International: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
103:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কিন্তু তারা নয়, যারা বিশ্বাস স্থাপন করে ও সৎকর্ম করে এবং পরস্পরকে তাকীদ করে সত্যের এবং তাকীদ করে সবরের।

104:1.Saheeh International: Woe to every scorner and mocker
104:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): প্রত্যেক পশ্চাতে ও সম্মুখে পরনিন্দাকারীর দুর্ভোগ,

104:2.Pickthall: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.
104:2.Saheeh International: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
104:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যে অর্থ সঞ্চিত করে ও গণনা করে

104:3.Pickthall: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.
104:3.Saheeh International: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
104:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে মনে করে যে, তার অর্থ চিরকাল তার সাথে থাকবে!

104:4.Pickthall: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.
104:4.Saheeh International: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
104:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কখনও না, সে অবশ্যই নিক্ষিপ্ত হবে পিষ্টকারীর মধ্যে।

104:5.Pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!
104:5.Saheeh International: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?

104:6.Pickthall: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,
104:6.Saheeh International: It is the fire of Allāh, [eternally] fueled,

104:7.Pickthall: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).
104:7.Saheeh International: Which mounts directed at the hearts.

104:8.Pickthall: Lo! it is closed in on them
104:8.Saheeh International: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them

105:1.Pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?
105:1.Saheeh International: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
105:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনি কি দেখেননি আপনার পালনকর্তা হস্তীবাহিনীর সাথে কিরূপ ব্যবহার করেছেন?

105:2.Pickthall: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,
105:2.Saheeh International: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
105:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি কি তাদের চক্রান্ত নস্যাৎ করে দেননি?

105:3.Pickthall: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,
105:3.Saheeh International: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
105:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি তাদের উপর প্রেরণ করেছেন ঝাঁকে ঝাঁকে পাখী,

105:4.Pickthall: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,
105:4.Saheeh International: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
105:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যারা তাদের উপর পাথরের কংকর নিক্ষেপ করছিল।

105:5.Pickthall: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?
105:5.Saheeh International: And He made them like eaten straw.
105:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতঃপর তিনি তাদেরকে ভক্ষিত তৃণসদৃশ করে দেন।

106:1.Saheeh International: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -

106:2.Pickthall: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.
106:2.Saheeh International: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
106:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আসক্তির কারণে তাদের শীত ও গ্রীষ্মকালীন সফরের।

106:3.Pickthall: So let them worship the Lord of this House,
106:3.Saheeh International: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
106:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব তারা যেন এবাদত করে এই ঘরের পালনকর্তার

106:4.Pickthall: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.
106:4.Saheeh International: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
106:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যিনি তাদেরকে ক্ষুধায় আহার দিয়েছেন এবং যুদ্ধভীতি থেকে তাদেরকে নিরাপদ করেছেন।

107:1.Pickthall: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?
107:1.Saheeh International: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
107:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আপনি কি দেখেছেন তাকে, যে বিচারদিবসকে মিথ্যা বলে?

107:2.Pickthall: That is he who repelleth the orphan,
107:2.Saheeh International: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
107:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সে সেই ব্যক্তি, যে এতীমকে গলা ধাক্কা দেয়

107:3.Pickthall: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.
107:3.Saheeh International: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
107:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং মিসকীনকে অন্ন দিতে উৎসাহিত করে না।

107:4.Saheeh International: So woe to those who pray

107:5.Pickthall: Who are heedless of their prayer;
107:5.Saheeh International: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -

107:6.Saheeh International: Those who make show [of their deeds]

107:7.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং নিত্য ব্যবহার্য্য বস্তু অন্যকে দেয় না।

108:1.Pickthall: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;
108:1.Saheeh International: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.
108:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): নিশ্চয় আমি আপনাকে কাওসার দান করেছি।

108:2.Pickthall: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
108:2.Saheeh International: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].
108:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অতএব আপনার পালনকর্তার উদ্দেশ্যে নামায পড়ুন এবং কোরবানী করুন।

108:3.Pickthall: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.
108:3.Saheeh International: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
108:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যে আপনার শত্রু, সেই তো লেজকাটা, নির্বংশ।

109:2.Pickthall: I worship not that which ye worship;
109:2.Saheeh International: I do not worship what you worship.
109:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আমি এবাদত করিনা, তোমরা যার এবাদত কর।

109:3.Pickthall: Nor worship ye that which I worship.
109:3.Saheeh International: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
109:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং তোমরাও এবাদতকারী নও, যার এবাদত আমি করি

109:4.Pickthall: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.
109:4.Saheeh International: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
109:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং আমি এবাদতকারী নই, যার এবাদত তোমরা কর।

109:5.Pickthall: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
109:5.Saheeh International: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
109:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তোমরা এবাদতকারী নও, যার এবাদত আমি করি।

109:6.Pickthall: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.
109:6.Saheeh International: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
109:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তোমাদের কর্ম ও কর্মফল তোমাদের জন্যে এবং আমার কর্ম ও কর্মফল আমার জন্যে।

110:1.Pickthall: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh
110:1.Saheeh International: When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,
110:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): যখন আসবে আল্লাহর সাহায্য ও বিজয়

110:2.Pickthall: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,
110:2.Saheeh International: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allāh in multitudes,
110:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং আপনি মানুষকে দলে দলে আল্লাহর দ্বীনে প্রবেশ করতে দেখবেন,

110:3.Pickthall: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.
110:3.Saheeh International: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
110:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তখন আপনি আপনার পালনকর্তার পবিত্রতা বর্ণনা করুন এবং তাঁর কাছে ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা করুন। নিশ্চয় তিনি ক্ষমাকারী।

111:1.Pickthall: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.
111:1.Saheeh International: May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
111:1.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): আবু লাহাবের হস্তদ্বয় ধ্বংস হোক এবং ধ্বংস হোক সে নিজে,

111:2.Pickthall: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.
111:2.Saheeh International: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
111:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): কোন কাজে আসেনি তার ধন-সম্পদ ও যা সে উপার্জন করেছে।

111:3.Pickthall: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
111:3.Saheeh International: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
111:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): সত্বরই সে প্রবেশ করবে লেলিহান অগ্নিতে

111:4.Saheeh International: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
111:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং তার স্ত্রীও-যে ইন্ধন বহন করে,

111:5.Pickthall: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.
111:5.Saheeh International: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.

112:2.Pickthall: Allah, the eternally Besought of all!

112:3.Pickthall: He begetteth not nor was begotten.
112:3.Saheeh International: He neither begets nor is born,
112:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি কাউকে জন্ম দেননি এবং কেউ তাকে জন্ম দেয়নি

113:2.Pickthall: From the evil of that which He created;
113:2.Saheeh International: From the evil of that which He created
113:2.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তিনি যা সৃষ্টি করেছেন, তার অনিষ্ট থেকে,

113:3.Pickthall: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense,
113:3.Saheeh International: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
113:3.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): অন্ধকার রাত্রির অনিষ্ট থেকে, যখন তা সমাগত হয়,

113:4.Pickthall: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft,
113:4.Saheeh International: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
113:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): গ্রন্থিতে ফুঁৎকার দিয়ে জাদুকারিনীদের অনিষ্ট থেকে

113:5.Pickthall: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.
113:5.Saheeh International: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
113:5.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): এবং হিংসুকের অনিষ্ট থেকে যখন সে হিংসা করে।

114:4.Pickthall: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer,
114:4.Saheeh International: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
114:4.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): তার অনিষ্ট থেকে, যে কুমন্ত্রণা দেয় ও আত্নগোপন করে,

114:5.Pickthall: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,
114:5.Saheeh International: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

114:6.Pickthall: Of the jinn and of mankind.
114:6.Saheeh International: From among the jinn and mankind".
114:6.Muhiuddin Khan (বাংলা): জ্বিনের মধ্য থেকে অথবা মানুষের মধ্য থেকে।
